name: Gran Erico Presence
original_name: グラン・エリコ・プレゼンス
source:
Born into a family of honourable knights, who are responsible for the protection of the country, he aspires to follow in the footsteps of his respected father and become a knight himself. His magical skills at the academy are top class. A central figure for the academy thanks to his encouraging disposition and leadership skills. Although he is friendly and somewhat pushy, he is trusted by everyone, and many students even idolise him. He is a good friend of Fin.

‘Let’s turn today into a good memory. Welcome to The Oriens Academy, Rika!’

[Translated from [url=http://www.daisy-daisy.in/products/majyu/]the official website[/url].]
